rounds.ai_message: Good morning, this is Tom from the knitting mill. How can I help you?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 早上好,我是针织厂的 Tom,请问有什么事?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明来意:需要找纬编针织面料,T 恤或内衣
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I want knitted fabric' — say 'I am looking for a weft knit fabric supplier' or 'I need single jersey cotton for T-shirts'
rounds.tips_zh: 开门见山:报用途(内衣/T 恤/运动)+ 成分

rounds.ai_message: OK. Single jersey, interlock, rib, pique, fleece — which one do you need?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。单面、双面、罗纹、珠地、毛巾布 — 您要哪种?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 选 single jersey(T 恤用)或 rib(领口用),不要太纠结
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I don't know' — pick one based on use: 'single jersey for T-shirts'

rounds.ai_message: Single jersey, 100% cotton, 180 GSM. Got it. What yarn count and what machine gauge are you targeting?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 单面,100% 棉,180 GSM。明白。您要的纱支是多少?机号多少?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 报 26s 或 32s 棉纱,机号 E24 或 E28
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'normal' — be specific: '26 Ne compact, E24 gauge'
rounds.tips_zh: 棉纱支数 + 机号 是基础,数字具体点

rounds.ai_message: For 26 Ne compact on E24, 180 GSM, we can do that on a Mayer & Cie circular knitting machine. 24-cut, 30 inch diameter, 78 feeders. What quantity?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 26 支紧密纺、E24、180 GSM,我们用 Mayer & Cie 圆机可以做。24 针、30 寸筒径、78 路。请问量是多少?
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I don't know' — give a rough number: 'monthly 8000 kg'
rounds.tips_zh: 机型号说出来,显得有常识

rounds.ai_message: 8000 kg per month is a healthy order. We can dedicate 4 machines to you. Lead time 30 days from greige approval, 45 days if you need dyeing. Lab dip in 5 days, dyeing lab dip 7 to 10 days.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 月用量 8000 公斤是稳定订单。我们可以专机 4 台做您的单。从坯布确认到出厂 30 天,如果要染色 45 天。坯布 lab dip 5 天,染色 lab dip 7-10 天。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认交期;问颜色管理(批差 ΔE);问分批
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'great' alone — '30 days from greige approval, lab dip in 5 days, 4 dedicated machines. Can you do 3 colors? 30/70 TT?'

rounds.ai_message: Yes, 3 colors is fine. Send me your Pantone codes. I'll have lab dips on your desk in 5 days. Once approved, 45 days for dyed fabric, FOB Shanghai. We accept TT 30/70. Anything else?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 可以,3 个颜色没问题。发我 Pantone 色号。5 天内 lab dip 到您桌上。确认后,染色 45 天,FOB 上海。我们接受 30/70 TT。还有问题吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认发 Pantone,确认 TT 30/70 接受,结束
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'thanks bye' — re-confirm: 'Will send 3 Pantone codes today. 5-day lab dip, 45-day bulk, TT 30/70. Looking forward to working with you.'
